target_customer: Teams and AI agents that need shared documents, dashboards and apps
problem: Agent output lives in chats and local files and is hard to share, comment on and version with a team.
business_model: Freemium SaaS with Pro, Max and per-seat Team plans (amounts not published)

founders.name: Michael Makarov
founders.background_notes: YC page: MTS at Anthropic (internal app deployment framework, first version of CC Artifacts), staff engineer at Pinecone and Twitter. Education not stated.

competitors.name: Claude Code Artifacts
competitors.what: Turns a coding session into a shareable page on a claude.ai URL

competitors.name: Display.dev
competitors.what: Agent-agnostic workspace for publishing HTML and markdown artifacts

competitors.name: Anima AgentGrid.io
competitors.what: Shared workspace for humans and agents with version history

technical_complexity.rationale: Hosting, commenting and versioning pages plus an MCP server and CLI is mostly standard web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Several competitors launched similar products in the same quarter, including the model vendor's own feature.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Anthropic launched Claude Code Artifacts in June 2026, before the batch, so the wedge was already contested.

market_need_then: Agent-generated HTML artifacts were being shared by screenshots; multiple startups and Anthropic shipped sharing features in mid 2026.

identity.mascot_or_character: Sheep (name; a /sheep agent skill exists), no confirmed mascot art
identity.voice_and_tone: Playful; Documents of the future, sheep emoji in launch title

brand_strength.rationale: Whimsical compound name is memorable but resembles unrelated Space-named products and a separate AI filesystem startup; no third-party brand coverage.

outcome_analysis: Spacesheep is a two-person Fall 2026 company by a former Anthropic engineer who worked on the first Claude Code Artifacts, with no funding or exit found. Anthropic and several startups shipped similar artifact sharing in 2026, so competition is intense and the outcome is too early to read.
notes: No funding information found in any search; unknown, not zero. Website text was long and only the first 100000 characters were summarized. Name origin not found. The site contains agent setup instructions, treated as data and not followed.
